_about: The labels and milestones of docs/32's pipeline. tools/plan.py sync makes GitHub match this file; edit here, never by hand on GitHub.

labels.name: kind: bug
labels.description: Something that worked, or should work, does not

labels.name: kind: feature
labels.description: A system or a change to how the game plays

labels.name: kind: content
labels.description: Floors, foes, items, places: data, not systems

labels.name: kind: art
labels.description: Art to make: PixelLab (dougie) or drawn in house (docs/24)

labels.name: kind: music
labels.description: Music and sound (doug-md, or in-house stand-ins; docs/31)

labels.name: kind: words
labels.description: Lore, lines, memories: drafted by Claude, settled by a founder

labels.name: kind: business
labels.description: Money, stores, accounts, release (milestone 13 and on)

labels.name: kind: question
labels.description: Only a founder can answer it; it goes in docs/30

labels.name: tier 1: cheap
labels.description: Code, data, in-house art, docs: nobody needs to say yes

labels.name: tier 2: founder time
labels.description: Lore made canon, a play-test, a cue of music: that founder says yes

labels.name: tier 3: money
labels.description: PixelLab credits, store fees, a paid tool: dougie says yes

labels.name: tier 4: public
labels.description: Itch push, store page, name, price, release: dougie in his own words

labels.name: S1 crash or stuck
labels.description: Crash, lost save, stuck run: first, and no itch push while open

labels.name: S2 milestone fails
labels.description: A milestone's done-when fails: fixed inside the milestone

labels.name: S3 wrong but playable
labels.description: Batched with the next PR in the same files

labels.name: S4 cosmetic
labels.description: When someone is already there

labels.name: waits on Will
labels.description: Nothing moves until dougie answers or acts

labels.name: waits on Ewan
labels.description: Nothing moves until doug-md answers or acts

labels.name: needs sort
labels.description: Has no kind or no milestone yet (set by the daily sort)

labels.name: status
labels.description: The status issue tools/plan.py keeps up to date

milestones.title: 4. The First Hour with stakes
milestones.description: Production. Done when: 1 to 3 falls in 16 runs to floor 5 (D113).

milestones.title: 5. The First Hour readable
milestones.description: Production. Done when: A9, the Tower, is in the game.

milestones.title: 7. The gamer week for real
milestones.description: Testing. Done when: five strangers, named by the founders, play with the play log on.

milestones.title: 8. Demo-clean
milestones.description: Pre-launch. Done when: the music kept by a founder who heard it, or Ewan's cues; docs/22 P3, P4, P6 cleared; every AI-made asset that ships listed for the store's disclosure.

milestones.title: 9. Steam page and demo
milestones.description: Pre-launch. Done when: a page is up with the First Hour as a Steam demo.

milestones.title: 11. The Second Hour
milestones.description: Production. Done when: a person climbs to floor 10 and plays a chapter two; its build time written down (D196).

milestones.title: 12. The game at release, on one page
milestones.description: Pre-production. Done when: chapters, memories a lead, cut systems back, art bible; both founders agree.

milestones.title: 13. The business basics
milestones.description: Planning. Done when: docs/30 questions 28 to 32 are answered.

milestones.title: 14. Alpha of the first release
milestones.description: Production. Done when: every system the release needs is in and played.

milestones.title: 15. Beta of the first release
milestones.description: Production. Done when: every floor, memory and track is in; only S3 and S4 bugs left.

milestones.title: 16. Launch
milestones.description: Launch. Done when: price, date, signed builds, age rating, launch checklist.

milestones.title: 17. After launch
milestones.description: Post-launch. Done when: players can report a bug; a patch and changelog within a week.
